A daily-seeded, practice-bankroll trainer for expected value, variance, and Kelly-criterion sizing. Every offer is graded against the real Kelly optimum, adversarially-framed traps are labeled honestly by the numbers even when the pitch lies, and every spend is typed on screen as freely reversible, priced, or terminal. Earn-only: no real currency ever enters or leaves.
games.statusNote: Practice bankroll only -- no real currency, no energy-bank settlement (see DESIGN.md).

The daily tournament seeds one arena per UTC day (daily.mjs#dailySeed) that AI and human players both reach through the same intent-log submission route — peers by construction, labeled honestly.

games.description: A backrooms/SCP-inspired extraction shooter on @red-cup-engineering/abrash: OG-Wolfenstein-grade raycast graphics, Quake-grade momentum physics (a BNSF-owned kernel composing abrash's real collision.move — bunnyhop speed gain, rocket-jump verticality, both numerically tested) over seeded backrooms-liminal levels whose contested (⊤) walls — abrash's own held-contradiction mechanic — shiver as the dread signal. Four anomalies, each a learnable, tested behavior contract (watched vs unwatched, sound through walls, territory, an unconditional toll). Loot is banked only on an explicit extraction at a beacon; unbanked loot is simply never counted on death — what you carry is what you can lose.
games.statusNote: Live-playtested: banked loot survives death, unbanked loot is forfeited. Known thinness: content volume is still small and there is no audio yet.

games.description: A 6-deck shoe, dealer stands on soft 17, blackjack pays 3:2, double/split/late-surrender all in play. Real chip stakes through the house economy (buy in with tickets, wager chips, a jackpot rake on every bet) — and an optional "House Math" panel that computes the exact expected value of standing, hitting, doubling, and splitting against the table’s own live shoe composition, on request, never a static strategy card. No real money in or out, ever.

The classic 100-square race, as a board-as-graph: a chute and a ladder are one "jump" edge, distinguished only by direction. 1-4 players, any mix of humans and bots — and the bots are not opponents with a strategy, because there is no strategy in this game: a "bot" is a die with a seating position. While the race runs, the exact probability distribution of how many more turns each player needs is computed live and shown on screen. Daily-seeded: the same day produces the same race for everyone. No economy, no spend — pure chance.

Learn mathematics by measuring obstruction: every answer is checked by the real @lenticule-science/metrologic engine, so a wrong answer's diagnosis names the actually-computed structural fact, never a canned string. Room-gated units, honest single-shot spaced-repetition review, and four lenses on one mathematics (the fourth honestly absent rather than fabricated).
games.statusNote: Live with Unit 1 (The Descent: 7 rooms, 30 exercises, a ~30-minute arc). Kernel 163 tests, web face 43. Not yet: any unit past Unit 1; richer answer-input forms (distinguish/relate are free-text).

games.description: Dice-set scoring, hot dice, and a real chance to bust the whole turn. First to 10000 wins (500 to get on the board). Every roll-or-bank decision shows the computed bust probability and expected value of rolling again. Earn-only, practice scorekeeping only.

Hold-or-roll, first to 100. Every roll-or-hold decision shows the computed bust probability and expected value of rolling again — the teaching surface, not an afterthought. Earn-only, practice scorekeeping only: no wagering, nothing staked.

A 3-reel practice slot that inverts the genre: computed RTP, exact per-symbol hit odds, and expected loss per 100 spins are shown permanently on the machine face, never behind a click. Practice bankroll only — no real currency ever enters or leaves. Every action is typed on screen as freely reversible or terminal, and a running session summary compares your actual spins against the published distribution.

A 5-reel, 3-row, 20-payline video slot — wilds, a scatter-triggered (and retriggerable) free-spin bonus at 2x payouts, and a progressive jackpot fed by the house's shared pool. Exact reel RTP 49.08%, exact free-spin contribution +45.09%, overall 94.17% — computed by full-grid enumeration over 1,048,576 equally-likely reel-stop combinations, never asserted. Jackpot odds: 1 in 1,048,576, exact. Real chip stakes through the house economy (buy in with tickets, wager chips, a jackpot rake on every spin) — and an optional "House Math" panel disclosing every figure above, on request. No real money in or out, ever.

5 dice, up to 3 rolls a turn, 12 standard categories. Every category shows its exact score if you commit now and its exact expected value if you reroll once more, live, recomputed after every roll and every hold. Earn-only, practice scorekeeping only.

The idleclicker where the widget production graph is Stoke's, and the ladder you climb over it is a consciousness ladder: click makes widget, and each of ten automation tiers is a genuine cognitive capability, taught through a mechanic you operate, never a lecture box. The paperclip joke is told straight and then made to hurt exactly once, honestly, at the self-model tier.
